rule: docs/slices/locale-1.md § 16.2 items 5-6 and packet rule 5: every key this slice allocates (39 catalog keys, 21 shared commerce keys) maps to at least one check, and every plural category of every count key, per registered language (`<part>.<key>@<language>.<category>`), too — a captured URL of a serving-contract row (fixture + path; the expectation file of that row — ro-expected.json (ro) or text-expected.json (en) — must list the key there, with a count of that category for a category entry) or a named unit test (file + a substring of its title). Checked by renderer/test/unit/locale-coverage.test.ts (the checker of locale-1a, extended and renamed by 1b), which also fails when a schema key is allocated to no slice.
